rules: A readmission is the owner coldkey re-entering an existing agent lineage: opting an existing agent into a new benchmark era, or re-running an unchanged agent after one of its evaluations completed. An identical or near-identical re-upload of the owner's own agent counts as one.
A readmission costs exactly the upload fee, is paid the same way, and counts toward and starts the same owner-coldkey upload cooldown.

The fee applies from benchmark v19 and goes live no earlier than 7 days after it is announced (activation.effective_at). Nothing submitted before then is charged as a readmission, and nothing is readmitted automatically.

ditto readmit AGENT_ID re-enters one of your finalized agents from the previous era into the active one. POST /api/v1/readmission/check refuses before payment: not your agent, a partial (2 of 3) row, withdrawn, retired, below the screening-policy floor, no screened image, already admitted, a rollout open, or the cooldown. At most one paid readmission per agent per era; payouts still count only the owner's best agent.
A refusal found only after payment keeps the payment as an upload credit for the same hotkey for 30 days. Ditto never refunds TAO on chain.

Retries caused by Ditto, its queue, validators or data (stalls, stranded evaluations, issuance gaps, validator crashes, provider outages, expired leases the agent did not cause, and Ditto's own re-tests such as season rotation and catch-up) are always free. Eligibility comes only from recorded validator and queue error codes, never from a request. Free re-leases are capped at 6 failed leases per agent per era; a failure the agent caused is remedied by a paid re-run or a new upload, never a free retry.
